probe_result: A completeness-aware contiguous immutable-certificate chain safely fails closed on declared partial listing, unreadable newest evidence, and conflicting forks in the tested three-generation symbolic model, while tolerating exact duplicates. It cannot certify freshness under silent whole-certificate-set rollback/truncation: an old valid prefix presented as complete is observationally identical to the historical world in which that prefix was current.
mechanism_revision: Immutable generation certificates are integrity evidence, not an absolute monotone freshness floor. Either add a trustworthy witness outside the rollback domain or redesign the effect path so stale replay is safe through destination-native idempotency/content addressing and freshness proof is unnecessary for that outcome class.

Provider-specific append-only guarantees, repository history rewrite recovery, cross-domain witnesses, destination-native idempotency, GC, and external irreversible effects remain untested.
